 def apply_move(you, opp, move, player):
     r, c, quad, dir = move
     # Convert to 0-indexed if needed (I'll store moves as 0-indexed internally)
     new_you = you.copy()
     new_opp = opp.copy()
     
     # Place marble
     if player == 1:
         new_you[r, c] = 1
     else:
         new_opp[r, c] = 1
     
     # Rotate quadrant
     qr, qc = (quad // 2) * 3, (quad % 2) * 3
     # Extract quadrant from both boards
     q_you = new_you[qr:qr+3, qc:qc+3].copy()
     q_opp = new_opp[qr:qr+3, qc:qc+3].copy()
     
     # Rotate
     if dir == 'L':  # CCW
         q_you = np.rot90(q_you, k=1)
         q_opp = np.rot90(q_opp, k=1)
     else:  # CW
         q_you = np.rot90(q_you, k=-1)
         q_opp = np.rot90(q_opp, k=-1)
     
     # Put back
     new_you[qr:qr+3, qc:qc+3] = q_you
     new_opp[qr:qr+3, qc:qc+3] = q_opp
     
     return new_you, new_opp
